config.hypothesis: This is the test arm of a seed-24 width-shrink test. Setup: m2 fixed at 0.5, data_seed 0, e in [0, 0.5], 4 layers, d_model=64, best-of-3 controls, seed 24, N=128, 6000 steps. Prediction: at d_model=64 the N=128 trained force R2 is lower than at d_model=128 (0.78436, layer 1, run-20261016-060747-3fef), and the same-seed d_model=64 N=64 minus N=128 gap against the paired arm proposed this cycle is >= 0.077. That would be a width-driven shrink of at least 25% relative to the d_model=128 gap of about 0.058. All values come from probes_final, unrounded, with layers reported and cross-layer pairs flagged. A layer-1 same-layer gap is also reported wherever both arms list layer 1. Within-run values are read only as same-layer control plus margin, never from the max-over-layers trajectory field. Both arms' run IDs are cited as evidence. If the paired arm is unavailable, the gap is reported as not computed.
